snippet.title: FLAK Simulator  | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Work together to operate a shared gun in Simulator mode, or control your own gun with an automated crew in Arcade mode. Engage incoming bomber formations in daytime and nighttime missions. the fuse, load the shell, and coordinate your fire. Every shot takes timing. Every crew member counts.

Follow the development of FLAK Simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268810/Flak_Simulator/
